title: Uplifting Briny Mediterranean Rest-meat Tagine
description: A savory, comforting dish that's perfect for a relaxing evening, with the rich flavors of the Mediterranean and the gentle warmth of palm sugar.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the onion and cook, stirring occasionally, until softened and lightly browned, about 8 minutes.
Add the garlic, oregano, cumin, smoked paprika, salt, and pepper, and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the rest-meat and cook, stirring occasionally, until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Add the palm sugar, parsley, and lemon juice, and stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a simmer, then cover the pot and transfer it to the preheated oven.
Braise the tagine, uncovered, in the preheated oven at 300°F (150°C) for 25 minutes, or until the rest-meat is tender.
Remove the pot from the oven and let it cool slightly.
Serve the tagine hot, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
